Subject ............ Monsieur and Madame A. DUFOUR --- Movements.

Made by.... D.S. Larby. .................... Forwarded by. (verbal)

With reference to the enquiry from the French Police
regarding the where·bouts of Monsieur and Madame A. Dufour,
I have to state that Monsieur Dufour accompanied by his wife
arrived at the Central Mansions, 941 Bubbling Well Road, on
the 8.11.36; their previous address was given as the "Hotel
Moderne", Tientsin. On the 10.11.36 the couple removed to
the Park Hotel where Monsieur Dufour is at present employed
as an entertainer.

D. S. Larby.
L D. S.

Copies 2. to Mr Smalley
D/S 14/11

D. C. Special Branch.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / B / 14 NOV 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

制作人.... D.S. Larby。 .................... 转呈人。（口头）

关于法国警方查询 A. Dufour 先生及夫人下落一事，
兹陈述如下：Dufour 先生在其妻子陪同下，于 1936 年 11 月 8 日抵达静安寺路 941 号中央公寓（Central Mansions）；其此前地址为天津“现代饭店”（Hotel Moderne）。1936 年 11 月 10 日，该夫妇搬至国际饭店（Park Hotel），Dufour 先生目前受雇于该处，担任艺人。

D. S. Larby。
L D. S.

副本 2 份，致 Smalley 先生
D/S 14/11

特别分部副督察。
